import csv, hashlib, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
p=root/'raw/new-tender-notices.csv'
with p.open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
 reader=csv.DictReader(f)
 titles=[k for k in reader.fieldnames if re.search('title|titre',k,re.I)]
 fields=[k for k in reader.fieldnames if re.search('title|titre|solicitation|reference|closing|url',k,re.I)]
 rows=list(reader)
assert titles
pattern=re.compile(r'reconcil|\bcatalog|inventory|inventaire|spreadsheet|tableur|data quality|qualit. des donn.es',re.I)
hits=[{k:r[k] for k in fields} for r in rows if any(pattern.search(r.get(k) or '') for k in titles)]
out={'scope':'New-notice titles only. Original notices govern eligibility and acceptance. No hit does not establish absence of demand.','source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'rows':len(rows),'title_fields':titles,'hit_count':len(hits),'hits':hits[:12]}
(root/'new-notice-title-screen.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(out)[:3000])
